status: retrospective exploratory; previous outputs/results known; rule frozen before this new replay
rule: Attempt unchanged whole-response schema parser. On failure, scan opening braces in character order, apply JSONDecoder.raw_decode, and choose the first successfully decoded object. Apply original schema exactly once; stop even if invalid. No syntax repair, no tool-call argument extraction, no retries or model calls. Wrapper labels are ignored by scanning, not converted. A brace in prose or a larger malformed structure can become a candidate.
comparison: Score all 2232 retained responses with original strict, one-fence, and first-object rules. Preserve original schemas, labels and scoring. Verify strict/normalized scores against stored CSV. Report all differences including content changes and failures; do not search for a rule that induces reversal.
primary_revision_summary: All-response acceptance and score agreement; E1 correction binding minus boundary interaction aggregated over task repetitions; E2 correction binding_a minus boundary interaction at paired task level. No new inferential intervals or reclassification of original primary analyses.
